title: Reading Common Words and Labels
introduction: Practise reading common words and labels with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Labels identify things. Common words help us understand short phrases and signs.
rules: Use pictures and known letter patterns to help identify new words.
Make a small picture dictionary with words grouped by topic.

vocabulary.description: An opening with a movable panel.

examples.question: Which sign tells you not to continue?
Which word means a way out?
steps: Use pictures and known letter patterns to help identify new words.
